title: Flux 2 LoRA Gallery Multiple Angles
description: Generates same object from different angles (azimuth/elevation)

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URL of the image to adjust camera angle for. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: horizontal_angle
inputs.tooltip: Horizontal rotation angle around the object in degrees. 0°=front view, 90°=right side, 180°=back view, 270°=left side, 360°=front view again.

inputs.name: vertical_angle
inputs.tooltip: Vertical camera angle in degrees. 0°=eye-level shot, 30°=elevated shot, 60°=high-angle shot (looking down from above).

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.tooltip: Camera zoom/distance. 0=wide shot (far away), 5=medium shot (normal), 10=close-up (very close).

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the size of the input image will be used. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enable the safety checker. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the output image.

inputs.name: lora_scale
inputs.tooltip: The strength of the multiple angles effect.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
